channel.description: Monday through Friday get up to speed on the biggest headlines of the day with 5 Things. On Saturdays, get a break for your ears with good news from 5 Good Things. And at noon and Sundays, we take you beyond the headlines to help make sense of what everyone is talking about in politics and beyond with One Thing.

item.title: One of The Most Expensive House Races is Also a Referendum on Israel
item.itunes:title: One of The Most Expensive House Races is Also a Referendum on Israel
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
As Israeli voters head to the polls today, the Democratic litmus test over support for Israel is top of mind for voters in the most expensive US House race in the country. Rep. Jared Moskowitz speaks to CNN about why he is not changing his pro-Israel stance despite a nationwide wave of progressive blowback. 

--- 

Guest: Edward-Isaac Dovere, CNN Senior Reporter 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin

item.title: Should Dems Dare to Dream in Mississippi?
item.itunes:title: Should Dems Dare to Dream in Mississippi?
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
A top Republican super PAC is making late ad buys in a state that would have been unthinkable not long ago: Mississippi. While party officials may not think they will actually lose the Senate race in the GOP stronghold, it speaks to the rapid rise of Democratic nominee Scott Colom. We look at what a growing “blacklash” against GOP voting moves looks like. 

--- 

Guest: Fredreka Schouten, CNN National Political Writer 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin
